statements.status_notes: node-forge 1.4.0 is the latest npm release and Scout reports no fixed version for CVE-2026-85393 (improper verification of cryptographic signatures). The Postman MCP server image ships this version from bundled node_modules installed via the postman-mcp package. A patched node-forge release and pnpm override in the package build are required to remediate; assessment of reachable signature verification in the MCP server workload is pending.

node-forge 1.4.0 is the latest npm release and Scout reports no fixed version for CVE-2026-85393 (improper verification of cryptographic signatures). The Postman MCP server image ships this version from bundled node_modules installed via the postman-mcp package. A patched node-forge release and pnpm override in the package build are required to remediate; assessment of reachable signature verification in the MCP server workload is pending.

CVE-2026-85393 is an improper verification of cryptographic signatures in node-forge. The director image ships node-forge 1.4.0 only as a transitive dependency of the minio client and related crypto-browserify bundles in the sorry-cypress director payload. Scout reports no fixed npm release for 1.4.x. Assessment of reachable signature verification paths and adoption of a patched release are pending.
